title: McpSettings
description: GET/PUT /local/mcp/settings: source_access = whether the user's AI may read excerpts of client mail, Slack and meetings through the MCP source layer (off until the owner switches it on, decision T29); processing_tools = whether the in-conversation extraction tools get_pending_mail and submit_extractions are offered (off by default, they cost the AI about 15k tokens per packet; read when the MCP catalog is built, so it applies after the engine or the AI tool restarts). PUT takes one or both fields.
